cover.thesis: We match local strengths with global demand, assembling the people, technology and delivery capacity needed to turn an opportunity into a practical project.

overview.intro: Resource matching is the business: demand, talent, technology and trusted local delivery come together around a defined opportunity.

projects.lead: The problem is fragmented participation and liquidity, not a shortage of assets. Global assets still need local entrances.

blocks.title: Operating model
blocks.body: Market access / eligibility → distribution / permissions → trade execution / routing / liquidity → post-trade clearing / data.

blocks.title: Asset lifecycle
blocks.body: Asset → eligibility → distribution → order → routing → execution → clearing → lifecycle. VFlux connects specialist institutions rather than replacing them.

blocks.title: Strategy & roadmap
blocks.body: Start centralized with existing institutions; progressively migrate suitable functions on-chain. To C path: digital-asset perpetuals and spot → RWA spot → unified multi-asset account → on-chain finance.

blocks.title: Business model · planning scenario
blocks.body: Distribution, transaction and routing fees; infrastructure, data and clearing services; potential future liquidity / protocol income. Net economics depend on partner shares and costs. Defensibility: asset network + distribution / liquidity + routing / clearing / data; not a forecast.

projects.lead: Japanese demand and tight production capacity meet industrialized Chinese AI-video supply through a neutral cross-border platform.

blocks.title: Three business lines
blocks.body: AI manga / vertical short animation · AI advertising · AI education and training. Market entry begins with Japanese buyers and Chinese production studios.

blocks.title: Six-step transaction flow
blocks.body: Demand → matching → production → localization → Japanese quality acceptance → cross-border settlement. JPY collection and CNY settlement follow agreed acceptance.

blocks.title: Differentiation & revenue
blocks.body: Beyond generic crowdsourcing and single tools: matching, Japanese localization, quality acceptance and settlement. Planned service fees and other income are scenarios, not results.

blocks.title: Beta / MVP · planning only
blocks.body: Website beta in development. First transactions targeted for January–March 2027; validation timing and expansion are plans, not evidence of delivery or traction.
